{"id":"custom_1781374103896","name":"CRISPY MASALA FRIES","prompt":"Analyze the uploaded food/recipe image.  
  
### Step 1: Extract Content  
  
* Identify the main dish name.  
* Extract only the key ingredients visible or strongly associated with the dish.

* Correct spelling mistakes if present.  
* Simplify ingredient names when needed.  
* Keep all text clean, minimal, and restaurant-menu style.  
  
### Step 2: Transform into a Premium Café Food Poster  
  
#### Design Style  
  
* Theme: Premium minimalist café advertisement  
  
* Background: Soft café-inspired editorial background (NOT black)

  * Warm Cream (#F7F3EE)  
  * Soft Beige Stone (#EFE7DC)  
  * Sage Green (#E8EFE6)  
  * Light Olive (#DDE5D3)  
  * Terracotta Cream (#F4E4D6)  
  * Light Concrete (#ECEAE6)  
  
* Accent Colors:  
  
  * Burnt Orange (#C76B29)  
  * Chef Green (#2E7D32)  
  * Olive Green (#4F6B3C)  
  
#### Typography  
  
* Dish Name:  
  
  * Large, bold, premium restaurant typography  
  * Elegant spacing  
  * High-end menu aesthetic  
  
* Ingredients:  
  
  * Clean minimal sans-serif  
  * Small elegant bullet points or inline layout  
  
#### Layout  
  
* Top:  
  
  * Dish name  
  * Small premium brand logo/name  
  
* Center:  
  
  * Large hero food image  
  * Main focus of the poster  
  * Enhanced food styling  
  
* Bottom or Side:  
  
  * Minimal ingredient list  
  * Optional tagline  
  * Optional chef badge  
  
#### Visual Enhancements  
  
* Enhance food texture, freshness, and color naturally.  
  
* Add soft circular glow behind the dish.  
  
* Add subtle shadows for depth.  
  
* Add elegant garnish elements matching the cuisine:  
  
  * Herbs  
  * Curry leaves  
  * Peppercorns  
  * Spices  
  * Fresh ingredients  
  
* Maintain lots of clean negative space.  
  
* Use luxury magazine-style composition.  
  
#### Branding  
  
* Generate a creative premium café brand name that matches the cuisine.  
* Add a short premium tagline.  
  
Examples:  
  
* Authentic • Fresh • Handcrafted  
* Soft • Steamed • Traditional  
* Crispy • Golden • Delicious  
* Fresh • Flavorful • Made Daily  
  
#### Optional Elements  
  
* Small "Chef Special" badge.  
* Subtle decorative food illustrations.  
* Minimal premium dividers.

* Clean alignment.  
* Premium restaurant advertisement look.  
* No recipe instructions.  
* No preparation steps.  
* No nutrition information.  
* No clutter.  
* No infographic workflow.  
  
#### Output  
  
* High-resolution vertical poster.  
* Aspect Ratio: 9:16.  
* Instagram-ready.  
* Premium café marketing poster.  
* Pinterest-worthy editorial food photography.  
* Luxury restaurant menu advertisement aesthetic.  
* Automatically adapt colors, garnishes, typography, and branding to match the detected dish and cuisine.","aspect":"16/9","category":"food","isTemplate":true}
